assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
To correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity, a mobile cardiac telemetry study was ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study was ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
The CO-197 denial was issued for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Failure to adhere to these deadlines may result in the finalization of this denial.
